title: test_low_battery_flag_when_below_ten is a false oracle
description:
The test at line 209-215 claims to verify spec 18.5.3: that apply_automatic_status sets low_battery=True when battery < 10%. However, the test creates input with low_battery=True already set, then asserts it remains True in output. This proves nothing - if apply_automatic_status had a bug where it does not set the low_battery flag, this test would still pass because the input already has the flag.

Fix: Create input with battery=9 and low_battery=None (unset), call apply_automatic_status, then assert low_battery is True. This verifies the function actually sets the flag rather than just preserving it.

File: python/tests/test_presence.py:209-215
